tool.name: Download antiSMASH databases
tool.description: for use with the Antismash tool
tool.command: export PYTHONWARNINGS="ignore::FutureWarning" && mkdir -p '$out_file.extra_files_path'/antismash_databases_@TOOL_VERSION@ && #if $test == "true": touch '$out_file.extra_files_path'/antismash_databases_@TOOL_VERSION@/stub && #else: download-antismash-databases --database-dir '$out_file.extra_files_path'/antismash_databases_@TOOL_VERSION@ && #end if cp '$dmjson' '$out_file'

param.name: databases
param.label: Databases to download
param.option: All databases (PFAM, TIGRFam, ClusterBlast, MIBiG, RESFAM, ...)

param.name: test
param.label: Test mode (copy minimal test databases instead of downloading)
param.help: For CI testing only: skips the download and copies a minimal set of stub databases instead.

tool.help: This tool downloads the databases required by the antiSMASH tool (PFAM, TIGRFam, ClusterBlast, MIBiG, RESFAM, MITE, and others, in total roughly 1.5 GB of data) using antiSMASH's own ``download-antismash-databases`` script and registers them in the ``antismash_databases`` data table. The Antismash tool then uses them via the ``--databases`` option.
